game.title: Ashes 2063 (Enriched), played in GZDoomVR
game.distribution: Free: https://www.moddb.com/mods/ashes-2063/downloads (this install came from a PCVR hub, at C:\NonSteam\Ashes 2063 VR)
game.build_notes: Verified on the home PC (RTX), Windows 11, 2026-09-17, flat mode (+vr_mode 0) in a window.

api_notes: SendInput with scancodes works once the window is truly in front (verified-live 2026-09-17).

Plain SetForegroundWindow from the automation process FAILED here, and so did the ALT-tap trick; joining the foreground thread's input queue (AttachThreadInput) then BringWindowToTop + SetForegroundWindow + SetFocus worked every time. Without it, keys and clicks silently go nowhere and the captures look like 'the game ignores input'.
Mouse left click (SendInput MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTDOWN/UP) fires the weapon.

bindings.notes: NO keyboard key is bound to reload in ashes-vr.ini (only Pad_B). Bind one from the console: 'bind r +reload'. '+' needs Shift held (scancode 0x2A).

states.description: In a level with the player in control.

entry_points.description: Skip every menu: launch straight into MAP01 (Outskirts) in a window, on a COPY of the VR config so the VR settings are never rewritten.
entry_points.command: gzdoomvr\gzdoomvr.exe -iwad Resources reedoom-0.12.1 reedoom2.wad -file Resources\AshesSAMenu.pk3 Resources\lightmodepatch.pk3 Resources\Ashes2063Enriched2_23.pk3 Resources\Ashes2063EnrichedFDPatch.pk3 [extra pk3] -config gzdoomvr\ashes-flat-test.ini +vr_mode 0 +vid_fullscreen 0 +win_w 1280 +win_h 720 +set language enu -skill 3 +map MAP01
entry_points.notes: Run from C:\NonSteam\Ashes 2063 VR. The player starts holding the .45 revolver. Client area measured 1264x681 (not 1280x720) with these settings. Harness: ashes-2063-weapons/tools/gzdrive.py and revolver_test.py.

dispatch_notes: Standard GZDoom console: give <item>, bind <key> <command>, map <MAPxx>, quit. Several commands can be joined with ';'.

hazards: SteamVR / Virtual Desktop running in the background did not stop flat mode (+vr_mode 0) from working (verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1).

disproved.result: Nothing happens: reload has no keyboard binding in this config.

disproved.claim: SetForegroundWindow alone (or after an ALT tap) brings the game to the front from a background script.
disproved.result: Returned without focusing; input was lost.
